race.comment: PROFITABELLE (7) caught the eye on debut with a strong finishing effort at Randwick but couldn't quite follow that up in the LR Inglis Millennium despite the market support when finding trouble. Looks to have come on nicely during the break, fitted with two sharp trials. Bright showing anticipated. BLESSED EAGLE (1) is a Farnan colt on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott camp. Gave a bold sight and stretched out stylishly when scoring in most recent trial over the 1045m. Expect Clark to push forward and give them something to catch. ARTEMEX (6) returns a gelding for the Maher camp and has jumped out strongly in readiness, fitter for two trials. Should be competitive. WATSON'S BAY (4) is a Snitzel colt on debut for the Waller camp and gets J Mac from a good draw off two trials. Expect him to be thereabouts. Stablemate SAFFRON VEIL (10) has a red-hot Z Lloyd. Don't dismiss.
